description: This PHP script is a performance test runner for the JMESPath PHP library. It loads JSON test suites, runs expressions against data, measures execution time, and outputs timing results. It also handles environment setup such as autoloading and optional Xdebug configuration.

classes.name: JmesPath\Env
classes.description: A class managing environment setup and runtime creation for JMESPath expressions.

classes.name: Composer\XdebugHandler\XdebugHandler
classes.description: Handles Xdebug configuration for performance optimization.

methods.name: runSuite
methods.description: Executes a test suite JSON file, running all test cases and accumulating total execution time.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a single test case multiple times to measure and record its best execution time.
